items.title: Trump Cancels Planned Attack on Iran, Citing 'Serious Negotiations'
items.headline: Trump cancels scheduled military attack on Iran at Gulf leaders' request; warns full assault ready 'on a moment's notice'
items.summary: Trump posted on Truth Social that he told military leaders to stand down a planned strike after Qatar, Saudi Arabia and UAE leaders requested a pause, saying 'serious negotiations are now taking place.'

items.title: Trump says he's postponing 'scheduled attack of Iran tomorrow' at Middle East leaders' request
items.headline: Trump postpones May 19 Iran strike after Gulf state leaders intervene; peace deal must include 'NO NUCLEAR WEAPONS FOR IRAN'
items.summary: Trump told Hegseth and Joint Chiefs Chair Caine to be prepared for a full large-scale assault on a moment's notice if an acceptable deal is not reached.

items.title: Why Donald Trump Delayed a Planned Military Attack on Iran
items.headline: Newsweek: Trump delayed attack citing Gulf state lobbying; deal terms include enrichment moratorium and Hormuz reopening
items.summary: Analysis of why Trump stood down from a scheduled Iran strike, noting Gulf state lobbying and the outline of a potential deal.

items.title: IRGC threatened to destroy US bases in the southern Persian Gulf
items.headline: IRGC spokesperson Zolfagari: all US military facilities in Persian Gulf region to be destroyed; zero ships allowed through Hormuz in past 24 hours
items.summary: IRGC military spokesperson threatened to put all American military facilities in the region 'out of action in the near future' and confirmed total Hormuz blockade in the preceding 24-hour window.

items.title: Exclusive: U.S. and Iran closing in on one-page memo to end war, officials say
items.headline: US-Iran one-page MOU in progress: enrichment moratorium 12-15 years likely, Iran to remove highly enriched uranium, sanctions lifted
items.summary: US officials told Axios they are closing in on a framework MOU under which Iran would suspend enrichment for 12-15 years and ship out its highly enriched uranium in exchange for sanctions relief and Hormuz reopening.

items.title: US, Iran said closing in on framework for permanent deal, as Trump renews bomb threats
items.headline: Times of Israel: US-Iran framework deal within reach as Trump simultaneously threatens bombing 'at much higher level'
items.summary: Dual-track US posture: diplomatic momentum toward a framework agreement concurrent with Trump's escalating military threats creates negotiating ambiguity.

items.title: Iran rial at 1,775,000 IRR/USD on May 19 — down 2,000 from yesterday
items.headline: Iran rial stabilizes at 1,775,000 IRR/USD on May 19 — 11.25% below 2,000,000 portfolio threshold
items.summary: USD remittance rate in Iran's open market fell marginally to 1,775,000 IRR on May 19, continuing a modest plateau after earlier volatility.

items.title: Polymarket Iran markets snapshot — May 19, 2026
items.headline: Polymarket: US invasion before 2027 at 28% (down 4pp); peace deal June 30 at 32%; Iran airspace closure by May 24 at 28% (down 6pp)
items.summary: Markets shifted meaningfully after Trump's attack cancellation: US invasion probability fell 4pp to 28%, and near-term airspace-closure contracts also eased.
